text: U.S. stock markets have shown mixed performance today as investors weigh rising oil prices and geopolitical tensions against anticipation for major technology earnings. While the Dow Jones Industrial Average and S&P 500 have posted modest gains, the technology-heavy Nasdaq has faced pressure, with utilities and energy sectors leading the market while technology and communication services lag. The volatility is largely driven by a surge in crude oil prices—fueled by concerns over Middle East shipping disruptions—which has heightened inflation fears and impacted investor sentiment ahead of key reports from companies like Alphabet and Tesla.
